source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 timeout 120 python3 << 'PYEOF'
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
import time

print("Loading model...")
t0 = time.time()
llm = LLM(model='/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen2___5-7B-Instruct', gpu_memory_utilization=0.9)
t1 = time.time()
print(f"Model loaded in {t1-t0:.1f}s")

prompts = ['Hello, how are you?']
t2 = time.time()
output = llm.generate(prompts, SamplingParams(max_tokens=50))
t3 = time.time()
print(f'vLLM OK: {output[0].outputs[0].text[:200]}')
print(f'Generation time: {t3-t2:.2f}s')

prompts_batch = [f'Paraphrase: "The cat sat on the mat." Version {i}' for i in range(10)]
t4 = time.time()
outputs = llm.generate(prompts_batch, SamplingParams(max_tokens=100))
t5 = time.time()
print(f'\nBatch of 10: {t5-t4:.2f}s ({(t5-t4)/10:.3f}s per prompt)')
for i, o in enumerate(outputs[:3]):
    print(f'  [{i}]: {o.outputs[0].text[:80]}...')

print(f'\n=== SUMMARY ===')
print(f'Load time: {t1-t0:.1f}s')
print(f'Single prompt: {t3-t2:.2f}s')
print(f'Batch 10: {t5-t4:.2f}s ({(t5-t4)/10:.3f}s/prompt)')
PYEOF
